newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products gain on IPE futures strength.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products gain on IPE futures strength.

text.p: NWE oil products all firmed on Monday morning, principally because of IPE futures' strength, dealers said.
Gasoline gained by around $2 a tonne. One barge sold at $184.50 fob ARA. Rotterdam running refinery product continued to command a sizeable premium with one bid at $187 fob.

Heating oil was about $1 a tonne firmer as IPE gas oil futures gained. Rotterdam product was valued at around IPE July flat, but bids and offers were around $1 apart and there was little sign that demand would grow.
